@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+id: fetch_sensitive_files
+info:
+  name: Fetch sensitive files via SSRF
+  author: akto
+  severity: high
+
+requests:
+  - method: "{{Method}}"
+    path:
+      - "{{BaseURL}}"
+    body: "{{Body}}"
+
+    payloads:
+      filename:
+        - "/etc/passwd"
+        - "/etc/lsb-release" 
+        - "/etc/shadow" 
+        - "/etc/hosts" 
+        - "/proc/self/environ"
+        - "/proc/self/cmdline"
+        - "/proc/self/cwd/index.php"
+        - "/proc/self/cwd/application.py" 
+        - "/proc/self/cwd/main.py"
+        - "/proc/self/exe"
+    
+    attack: clusterbomb
+      
+    stop-at-first-match: false
+
+    matchers:
+      - type: status
+        status:
+          - 200
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+id: port_scanning
+info:
+  name: Scan ports
+  author: akto
+  severity: high
+
+requests:
+  - method: "{{Method}}"
+    path:
+      - "{{BaseURL}}"
+    body: "{{Body}}"
+
+    payloads:
+      port:
+        - "22"
+        - "80"
+        - "443"
+        - "8080"
+        - "27017"
+
+    matchers:
+      - type: regex
+        part: body
+        regex:
+          - '(?i)rejected'
+          - '(?i)refused'
+          - '(?i)timeout'
+          - 'MongoDB'
+        condition: or
\ No newline at end of file
